meta.attention: AC-022 要求 check-unused 对 lib 报告 0 个未使用项，且 scripts/check-fast.mjs 会无参运行 scripts/check-*.mjs，所以 check-unused 在 lib 上必须退出 0。但基准 f6f6057 上 lib/contract/validate.mjs:45 有一个未导出、全仓无引用的死函数 typeOf（T-004 遗留）。它不在 T-007 的 write_scope 内，所以按现在的范围，任务无法让 AC-022 通过。请问怎么处理？

text:
Your acceptance.md has 66 code fences but ZERO headings of the form "## AC-xxx" and ZERO lines printing "AC-xxx OK". The CI runner therefore extracted 0 commands and exited 2.

Contract (from tools/ci-runner.ps1 header). Every check MUST be:

## AC-020 Short title
- 命令: <one single-line command in backticks>
- 期望: ...

and the command MUST print the exact string "AC-020 OK" on success (exit 0 + that string = pass).

Rules:
1. Heading starts with the AC id, e.g. "## AC-020 ...". A descriptive heading without the AC id is ignored.
2. Put the command on a "- 命令: `...`" line. Fenced code blocks alone are not enough.
3. End every command with: ; Write-Output "AC-020 OK"
4. Cover each AC you own with its own section.
5. Commands run from a TEMP directory: use absolute file paths (file:///C:/... for ESM imports) and never rely on cwd.

Rewrite the whole acceptance.md in that shape. Do not patch it line by line.
